GST TDS / TCS Reconciliation

Upload the TDS and TCS Credit Received download from the GST portal to work out the taxable amount behind every credit, then match it month by month with your marketplace TCS reports.

GST portal TDS / TCS file(s) required

From Returns › TDS and TCS Credit Received (or the GSTR-2A Excel download) — CSV, Excel or ZIP, one or more months. Set the month for any file without a tax-period column.

📂
Click or drop the portal CSV / Excel / ZIP file(s) here
…or paste the table copied from the portal screen

Marketplace TCS reports optional

Sales and sales-return reports, e.g. Meesho's GST report ZIP as downloaded, or its tcs_sales.xlsx / tcs_sales_return.xlsx. Needs a taxable value column; the month is read from the month or date column.

📂
Click or drop the sales / returns report(s) or ZIP here

Settings

%
₹

Taxable amount from GST portal

Net taxable = gross value − value of supplies returned. The inter / intra-state split follows the IGST vs CGST + SGST share of each credit. Expected rate: TCS 1% up to June 2024, 0.5% from 10 July 2024 (July 2024 accepts either); TDS 2%.

Match with marketplace reports

Only TCS credits are matched. A mismatch usually means orders or returns the operator reported in a different month, or a GSTR-8 amendment — check that month's order-level report.

⇩ Download calculation & match as CSV

GST Return Filing Helper

The GSTR-1 and GSTR-3B figures for a month from your marketplace reports, what you actually have to pay after ITC and TCS credit, and when each return is due. Click any amount to copy it.

Input tax credit & cash ledger

ITC: the eligible credit in your GSTR-2B for the month (Table 4A). Cash ledger: filled in with the month's TCS / TDS credit from the portal file — add any other cash balance you have.

From the July 2025 return period the portal fills GSTR-3B Tables 3.1 and 3.2 from your GSTR-1 and they cannot be edited — use these figures to check them, and correct any difference through GSTR-1A before filing GSTR-3B. Set-off follows Section 49 / Rule 88A; the portal's own payment screen has the final say.
